title: Totem of Copper Golem
description: Turns your totem of undying into a copper golem
body:
### Totem of Copper Golem
When you looked at your copper golems, did you ever wish you could take them with you on your travels? With this resource pack, you can replace the Totem of Undying with a **Copper Golem Totem**, and you can even **choose the oxidation level**!

### Notice!
Each version is divided into 4 variants for each oxidation state:
- A - Clean
- B - Exposed
- C - Weathered
- D - Oxidized

### Galery and other projects
Also check out the [**Totem of Iron Golem**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/totem-of-iron-golem) resource pack!
